## Owner Rules

- Every session, on every host and in every project, reads the owner's cross-project rules (`standards/rules.md` in the private repository `Soulcreek/agent-home`) before its first action. The SessionStart hook prints them (`KOMBIFY_OWNER_RULES`); any other host runs `node scripts/kombify-bootstrap.mjs rules`. Only when that fails, follow this file and say once that the owner rules were not read.

## Planning System Policy

- For overall progress or the next implementation package, read the relevant M milestone and primary AP in workspace `OVERALL-ROADMAP.md`, then its current owning Beads issue, parent and actual dependencies. Product `ROADMAP.md` files own capability commitments; Beads owns executable status and claims. Workspace `ROADMAP.md` and `central:C<n>` labels are historical phase references, not the current execution order or progress measure (D-2026-11-07-01). Detail: `ISSUE-FLOW-STANDARD.md` "Task context and completion".

## Beads Remote Write Policy

- Mutate Beads only through `mise --cd <workspace-root> run beads:write --repo <manifest-id> -- <bd args>` and require `BEADS_REMOTE_WRITE_OK ... tracker=cloudflare`. Detail: workspace `BEADS-REMOTE-WRITE-STANDARD.md`.

## Public Beta Drift Guard

- Name the slice before feature work, fail closed on a missing prerequisite, prove "supported" at the current pin, keep `main` green, record bundled binaries in `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md` and keep the tracker current: workspace `DEVELOPMENT-THROUGHPUT-STANDARD.md` "Drift guard"; scheduled jobs and the workflows a session may dispatch: workspace `CI-CD-PLATFORM-STANDARD.md`.

## Git And Completion

- Work on the synced `main` or your own worktree (rule 5, D-2026-10-26-26). Publishing and the merge route: Start 4.
- Stable ships only through skill `.agents/skills/kombify-ship/SKILL.md` and `CI-CD-PLATFORM-STANDARD.md` §4.6. Pre-1.0 the slot ships every product (D-2026-10-31-02); a session runs `mise run release:attended -- --go D-2026-10-31-02` only when the owner asks. An urgent release (`mise run release:urgent`, D-2026-11-11-14) starts the same way: only on a release decision. From 1.0 only the owner's go ships (D-2026-10-20-07, D-2026-10-26-27) or a passed test window for the products it tested (D-2026-10-26-12); a `RELEASE_BLOCKER` goes to the owner in the same turn.
- Report committed, merged, deployed and live state separately, with evidence (rule 9).
